context: A phone call regarding a furniture delivery confirmation

turns.speaker: Narrator
turns.text: Questions 32 through 34 refer to the following conversation.

turns.speaker: Man
turns.text: Hello Ms. Tanaka, this is David from Apex Logistics. I'm calling to confirm your shipment of office furniture scheduled for delivery this Thursday afternoon.

turns.speaker: Woman
turns.text: Oh hello David! Yes, I was just checking our inventory space. Will the drivers be able to help unload the items onto the second floor? Our elevator is temporarily out of service today.

turns.speaker: Man
turns.text: Absolutely. I will assign two extra movers to your truck to ensure everything gets placed directly in the main conference room without any delay.

turns.speaker: Woman
turns.text: That's wonderful news! Please email me the updated delivery confirmation form so I can notify our facilities manager.
